reference_audio.note: ~3 s is enough for high-quality cloning.  If reference_text is omitted, cloning falls back to speaker-embedding-only mode.

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample as a base64 string.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...).  ~3 s is enough for high-quality cloning.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio.  If omitted, x_vector_only_mode is enabled automatically (speaker-embedding-only cloning; quality may be reduced).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en', 'zh', or 'auto' for auto-detection (supported: de, en, es, fr, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: x_vector_only_mode
parameters.description: Use only the speaker embedding (no reference transcript / in-context codes).  Cloning quality may be reduced.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature.  Omit for the engine default.

parameters.name: top_p
parameters.description: Nucleus sampling threshold.  Omit for the engine default.

parameters.name: repetition_penalty
parameters.description: Penalty applied to repeated tokens.  Omit for the engine default.
